svg.aria-label: Training a small U-Net on lesions that cover about 0.9 percent of pixels. Left: lesion IoU over training for cross-entropy alone and for cross-entropy plus Dice. Right: pixel accuracy for both stays near the score of predicting background everywhere, so it cannot tell the runs apart
